## Summary

The May 1, 2026 guide describes configuring offline mode for Terminal readers. With offline mode, the POS device can store payments locally during intermittent, limited, or absent connectivity. When a network connection returns, the Terminal SDK automatically forwards the stored payments to Stripe for processing.

## Dashboard and API

- From location details, edit **Offline mode** under **Local configurations** or **Inherited configurations**. From **Manage locations**, choose **Edit configuration** from the location's overflow menu, then choose **Edit** or **Override** beside **Offline mode**. Create a configuration first if you need a new one. Set the toggle, choose **Update**, then choose **Apply changes**.
- The May Dashboard guide says the offline-mode setting updates on the reader within 10 minutes.
- Create or update a Configuration object to set offline mode. The May guide uses `offline: { enabled: true }` to enable it. The separate November 7, 2026 Configuration API [create](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/configuration/create.md?query=offline) and [update](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/configuration/update.md?query=offline) references list the optional `offline` object for offline transaction settings.

terminal-fleet-offline-mode.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/offline-mode, source-stripe-terminal-offline-mode-config presents the November 7, 2026 capture as an offline-mode introduction and links for Dashboard and API. See new raw lines 5-14. The index itself gives no implementation steps, prerequisites or transaction state transitions. The May 1, 2026 full capture describes the merchant's POS device storing payments locally under intermittent, limited or absent connectivity, then the Terminal SDK automatically forwarding the stored payments to Stripe when connectivity returns. Forwarding is the described transition. See old raw lines 8-10. To change the setting, the merchant edits an existing relevant configuration or first creates one. From Dashboard location details or Manage locations, they select the Offline mode control, toggle, update and apply changes. The reader setting updates within ten minutes. The API branch uses Configuration create or update, with offline.enabled true in the examples. See old raw lines 16-37 and old raw lines 39-74. The pinned pre-update summary kept the May toggle and the two operational links, with a shorthand ten-minute propagation. The revised source specifies the within-ten-minutes bound, retains the operational links, and links the separate Configuration source for account and location hierarchy.
terminal-fleet-offline-mode.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/offline-mode, source-stripe-terminal-offline-mode-config adds the November 7, 2026 capture as a navigation raw reference. The feature sentence remains. The base page presents explicit Dashboard and API variant links in place of the old expanded sections. See new raw lines 5-14, old raw lines 4-16 and old raw lines 39-45. There is no demonstrated functional change. The revised source preserves May 1, 2026 evidence for local POS storage, automatic SDK forwarding after network recovery, location edits and apply step, configuration update within ten minutes and API create/update. See old raw lines 8-10, old raw lines 18-37 and old raw lines 43-74. The old location workflow selects the Offline mode row and toggle. The isolated passcode wording does not describe an extra prerequisite (old raw lines 18-25). The revised source adds the reciprocal stripe-terminal-hardware-orders route, links source-stripe-terminal-configurations for hierarchy, and keeps source-stripe-terminal-offline-payments and source-stripe-terminal-offline-collect-card-payments as distinct integration routes. The separate November Configuration create/update references list optional offline settings (raw/stripe-api-terminal-configuration-create-2026-11-07.md:44-45, raw/stripe-api-terminal-configuration-update-2026-11-07.md:58-59). The base offline-mode capture does not confirm the old operational constraints for November, and omission does not prove removal.
